audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 fits: matched waveclear, TF edges the roam war post-6 with proactive Destiny vs reactive Hero's Entrance. 54.11% over 2957 games supports slight TF lean.

audit.whatIsWrong: First-item row disagrees between layers: full phases[5].side says Skill while content win[5] and packet levelChart both say Twisted Fate.
audit.why: Content whys[5] and packet agree TF's first item plus Destiny out-tempos Galio; full layer left the row on Skill.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side moved to Twisted Fate with why rewritten to state the tempo edge; win[5] already correct so no content edit (a no-op would sink the group). All other rows agree across layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Idol of Durand' is a fabricated ability name (real W: Shield of Durand) in spikes[3].text and late. Justice Punch called a 'taunt' in wants.foe[2] — it is a knockup; the taunt is Shield of Durand. breakdown.cooldowns had no digit. Missing: W/R shields absorbing TF's burst, and Justice Punch's knockup interrupting a Gate channel.
audit.why: enemyKit: E 'knocking up the first enemy champion', 11/10/9/8/7s; W taunt+shield 18-14s; R 180/160/140s with shield+knockup; Q 825 range projectile.
audit.corrected: Names and CC types fixed; cooldowns field now carries 11s/7s E, 18s W and 180s R; shield-absorbs-burst woven into enemyWin and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two of three suspectNames are false positives ('Gold Card' is TF's W card; 'Use Hero's Entrance' is the real R name). The third, 'Idol of Durand', is a genuine fabrication and is fixed.

edits.before: Lich Bane spike: gold card chunks half bars. The lane still isn't the point — the map pays your salary.
edits.after: Lich Bane spike: gold card chunks half bars, and your clear now outpaces his — the map pays your salary.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W gold card for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Justice Punch is 11s at rank 1, 7s max — his only engage; step up on its downtime. - Shield of Durand runs 18s early: W and E both down means no taunt, no knockup. - His R is 180s; yours is 170s — track both.

edits.before: Galio wins by landing Justice Punch, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Galio wins by landing Justice Punch's knockup into his W taunt — Durand's shield eats your burst as the combo lands.

edits.before: Lock gold off-screen, walk up once, card-auto-Q, and leave — one stun-chunk per cycle is all the lane asks of you.
edits.after: Wild Cards outrange his 825-range Winds of War — throw from beyond it and his poke never gets to answer your shove.

edits.before: Cycling cards inside his engage range for stacked-deck greed — TF dies in exactly one mistimed auto-walk per game; don't pre-book it.
edits.after: His W taunt plus knockup wins any extended brawl — Durand's shield eats your burst; stun-chunk once and step out before the E lands.

edits.before: Galio is a peel/engage tank in fights with a huge taunt; use Destiny to catch him alone or roam to other lanes for numbers, and avoid grouping into his Idol of Durand when your team is clumped.
edits.after: Galio is a peel/engage tank in fights with a huge taunt; use Destiny to catch him alone or roam to other lanes for numbers, and avoid grouping into his Shield of Durand when your team is clumped.

edits.before: Your first item plus Destiny keeps you ahead on tempo, out-clearing and out-roaming a Galio stuck choosing between shoving mid and saving allies. With two-plus items it's a skill matchup, decided by whether you use Destiny to catch him alone and avoid feeding his Idol of Durand into a grouped team.
edits.after: Your first item plus Destiny keeps you ahead on tempo, out-clearing and out-roaming a Galio stuck choosing between shoving mid and saving allies. With two-plus items it's a skill matchup, decided by whether you use Destiny to catch him alone and avoid feeding his Shield of Durand into a grouped team.

edits.before: Land Justice Punch taunt to lock you for his combo
edits.after: Land the Justice Punch knockup to start his combo

notes: SuspectNames: 'Gold Card' and 'Use Hero's Entrance' are false positives; 'Idol of Durand' was a real fabrication, fixed in both spikes[3].text and late. Justice Punch corrected from taunt to knockup (the taunt is Shield of Durand); spikes[2].text's 'flash-taunt' left alone — flash-W is a real Galio play. Gate-interruption missingInteraction (Justice Punch knockup cancels your 1.5s Gate channel) is plausible from the kit but channel-interruption specifics are not in Riot's text — not asserted, recorded here as unverified. phases[5].side aligned with win[5]/packet; no win[] edit since content already agrees. sectionsMissing: breakdown.carry, breakdown.feeding, ahead, breakdown.late judged templated but no Galio-specific replacement available without inventing; left.
